clusters.headline: Cyclone Akvan Weakens Into Depression As Heavy Rains Hit Odisha
aiSummaryBullets: Cyclone Akvan has dissipated into a depression, though lingering weather systems continue to bring heavy rainfall to parts of Odisha and West Bengal.
Local administrations in Andhra Pradesh are managing water release from reservoirs following flooding in districts including Srikakulam.

clusters.headline: Police Deny House Arrest Of Sonam Wangchuk Amid Ladakh Local Polls
aiSummaryBullets: Leh authorities stated that activist Sonam Wangchuk was not under house arrest, reversing previous reports of confinement.
The activist had previously alleged that he was restricted to his residence beginning November 11 due to protests.

clusters.headline: PM Narendra Modi Commemorates Platinum Jubilee At IIT Kharagpur
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the Platinum Jubilee celebrations marking 75 years of IIT Kharagpur.
The Prime Minister encouraged students to overcome limiting beliefs to contribute to national growth.

clusters.headline: BJP Criticizes Rahul Gandhi Over Remarks On Foreign Policy And State
aiSummaryBullets: The BJP has engaged in a public dispute with Rahul Gandhi, questioning his understanding of global geopolitics and domestic policy.
Rahul Gandhi advocated for strong India-Israel relations and discussed his perspective on India's role in the international landscape.

clusters.headline: Indian Ministry Of Defence Finalizes INS Betwa Propulsion Upgrade
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Defence entered a contract worth 498 crore rupees for the maintenance and refit of the naval frigate INS Betwa.
This initiative is part of broader naval modernization efforts within the Indian defence sector.

clusters.headline: Delhi Police Apprehend Teen For Selling Stolen Agniveer Data Online
aiSummaryBullets: A 14-year-old was taken into custody by Delhi police for allegedly hacking a test portal.
The youth is accused of stealing sensitive recruitment data related to the Agniveer program.

clusters.headline: Tamil Nadu Orders Quarry Fencing And Receives Court Rulings
aiSummaryBullets: State authorities mandated the installation of fencing around all abandoned quarries to improve public safety and prevent accidents.
The Supreme Court granted permission for a one-time Karthigai deepam lighting ritual near a dargah located on a hillside in Tamil Nadu.

clusters.headline: Yogi Adityanath Mourns Death Of Mother As Drug Peddling Fight Starts
aiSummaryBullets: Savitri Devi, the mother of Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, has died at the age of 91.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Chief Minister of Telangana have extended their condolences to the Adityanath family.

clusters.headline: Congress And Samajwadi Party Continue Seat Sharing Talks In UP
aiSummaryBullets: The Samajwadi Party is reportedly considering an initial offer of 24 seats to the Congress for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections.
Formal seat-sharing discussions between the two parties were recently deferred following a meeting between Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav.

clusters.headline: Amul And Mother Dairy Milk Price Hikes Continue Amid Market Shifts
aiSummaryBullets: Amul and Mother Dairy implemented price increases of up to 4 to 6 rupees per litre for milk products starting in mid-November.
Onion production has been negatively impacted by drought conditions, resulting in retail prices reaching 70 rupees per kilogram.

clusters.headline: Twenty Four People Die Following Bus Collision In Assam India
aiSummaryBullets: At least 24 individuals were killed after a minibus and a trailer truck collided in the Indian state of Assam.
Casualties include several children, college students, and the bus driver, according to government officials.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Rejects Separate Hearing Plea on Election Law Verdict
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India denied a request to separately list an application challenging a split verdict on Election Commissioner appointment laws.
Chief Justice of India indicated that a five-judge Bench may evaluate the recall application despite the retirement of one presiding judge.

clusters.headline: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik Attends SCO Civilisations Dialogue
aiSummaryBullets: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik traveled to Delhi to participate in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisations Dialogue Forum.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated the event serves as a platform for dialogue on civilisations rather than conflicts.

clusters.headline: Nikhil Gupta Sentenced To 19 Years For Sikh Separatist Plot In US
aiSummaryBullets: Nikhil Gupta received a 19-year prison sentence for his role in a conspiracy to murder a Sikh activist in New York City.
The defendant pleaded guilty to multiple charges including murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder, and money laundering earlier this year.

clusters.headline: Renowned Modernist Indian Artist Arpita Singh Passes Away At 89
aiSummaryBullets: Arpita Singh, a prominent figure in the Indian modernist art scene, has died at the age of 89.
She was honored with the Padma Bhushan in 2011 for her significant work in the arts.

clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Remains In Very Poor To Severe Categories
aiSummaryBullets: Most monitoring stations in Delhi continue to record air quality levels classified as very poor or severe.
Specific locations including IIT-Delhi have reported air quality index readings exceeding 400.

clusters.headline: PM Modi Reviews Domestic Policy Priorities And Economic Progress
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged corporate leaders to increase workforce size and wages following recent corporate tax reductions.
The Prime Minister disputed claims of economic instability by citing the number of citizens who have moved out of poverty over the last 13 years.

clusters.headline: Political Developments In Uttar Pradesh Amidst Recent Statements
aiSummaryBullets: Hardeep Singh Puri has officially resigned from his seat in the Rajya Sabha representing Uttar Pradesh.
A member of the legislative assembly, Raja Bhaiya, publicly advocated for increased unity among followers of the Hindu faith.

clusters.headline: TMC Official Questioned And CRPF Jawan Terminated Over Social Posts
aiSummaryBullets: Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee attended a police station for questioning regarding a May social media post.
The FIR against Banerjee follows allegations that he targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the Gujarati community.

clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Reflects On Life And Politics In New Memoir Belonging
aiSummaryBullets: Sonia Gandhi is set to release her memoir titled Belonging: A Journey of Love, detailing her transition from a private life to public politics.
The book covers her personal experiences with loss, her decision to decline the Prime Minister position, and her reflections on the Emergency period.
